content.short: WheelX is an AI-powered bridge and swap aggregator for moving any token across 50+ chains.
content.description: WheelX aggregates more than 200 bridges, DEXes and AMM pools across 50+ blockchains, routing cross-chain swaps and transfers through the cheapest and fastest path in one click. Blockscout's Unichain and World Chain marketplaces list it, and growthepie labels WheelX contracts on Unichain.
content.meta: WheelX aggregates 200+ bridges and DEXes for cross-chain swaps on Unichain, World Chain and more.
